text_markup: Some abilities look for particular conditions occurring "during a run" or are restricted to being used "during a run." For purposes of abilities, the run formally begins only after the attacked server is announced and any costs are paid.
text_plain: Some abilities look for particular conditions occurring "during a run" or are restricted to being used "during a run." For purposes of abilities, the run formally begins only after the attacked server is announced and any costs are paid.

examples.text_markup: The Runner initiates a run against a server with a rezzed {card:Heinlein Grid} while the Corp has {card:Enhanced Login Protocol} in play. They do not lose any credits to {card:Heinlein Grid}'s ability, as the additional click {card:Enhanced Login Protocol} requires them to spend is spent to initiate the run, and is not spent during the run.
